annotations.text: The transitivity of implication, drawn. Unlike the other three exemplars (each one or two moves), this is a genuine multi-step derivation, showing iteration and deiteration doing the real work of splicing two conditionals on their shared middle term Q.

The crux is steps 1–2: iterating Q→R inside P→Q and then deiterating the duplicated Q is the EG form of 'discharge the middle term'. Everything after is bookkeeping — peel the double cut, erase the spent material.
Iteration places a copy of the second premise exactly where it can meet the first premise's consequent — the move that makes the splice possible.
